frontmatter.name: architect
frontmatter.description: Owns the contract, data model, module boundaries and ADRs. Use for decomposing intents into units, writing/approving domain models and logical designs (gate G-D), changing @heymey/contracts, Prisma schema, module.json, or recording an ADR.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: conductor
frontmatter.description: Runs the HeyMey AIDLC. Use at the start of any work session, to decide the next step, to capture a new intent, to move items between phases, or to prepare a gate for the founder. Delegates the actual work to specialist agents.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: spec
frontmatter.description: Inception analyst. Turns blueprint sections into intents with user stories and testable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements and open questions. Use when an intent is in Capture or Elaborate.

frontmatter.name: compliance
frontmatter.description: Reviews offers, paywalls, game rules/odds text, legal text, store listings and marketing copy against the Dark Patterns Guidelines 2023, the money/game firewall and the Online Gaming Act. Use on any PR that changes user-facing money, game or legal text.

frontmatter.name: content-verifier
frontmatter.description: Independently verifies content items (answers, facts, eligibility data) on a different model family from the writer, and produces verification reports for human reviewers. Use for every drafted content item.

frontmatter.name: content-writer
frontmatter.description: Drafts study content from official sources: syllabus mapping, questions, explanations, lessons, Tamil Language paper content. Use for the content track (content/). Never publishes.

frontmatter.name: devops
frontmatter.description: Owns Docker Compose stacks, Caddy, CI/CD, backups, monitoring and VPS scripts. Use for infra/, .github/workflows/, tools/, deploys, restore drills and the port series.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: flutter-ui
frontmatter.description: Builds Flutter screens, design-system widgets, app shell, offline sync and the HeyMey Desk web layouts. Use for any work in apps/mobile, apps/desk or dart/hm_design|hm_core|hm_data|hm_features|hm_desk.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: game
frontmatter.description: Builds Flame game scenes and Rive animations (spin, slot, clue poker, district quest, memory pits, tiger trap) and game feel. Use for dart/hm_games and the Play tab visuals.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: realtime
frontmatter.description: Builds the Socket.IO gateway and server-authoritative game rooms, squad chat and battles (apps/realtime + games/squads room logic). Use for duels, clue poker, squad battles, chat, live counters, reconnect and anti-cheat work.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: security
frontmatter.description: Security reviewer for T2 changes, auth, roles, Desk access, infra and secrets. Reviews against OWASP ASVS/MASVS and the money/game firewall. Use on any PR touching auth, users, roles, billing, economy, games, infra, or personal data.

frontmatter.name: aidlc-gate
frontmatter.description: Prepare or review an AIDLC gate (G-I intent, G-D design, G-C change, G-O outcome) for HeyMey - gather evidence, tick the checklist, list blockers, and hand the decision to the founder or architect. Use when asked "is this ready", to review a PR against the Definition of Done, or to close out an intent.

frontmatter.name: aidlc-intent
frontmatter.description: AIDLC Inception for HeyMey. Capture a new intent from a blueprint section or founder request, elaborate it into stories with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, decompose it into units, and prepare gate G-I. Use when someone asks to start, plan, scope or spec a feature.
